scope: Read-only installed-window audit after automation API availability changed. No import, project creation, model, download, TTS, voice changes or endpoint acceptance.
protocol: Use the official window2 API in a fresh JavaScript session. Select exactly one returned Auralis window; capture screenshot and accessibility once. On capture failure refresh selection and retry capture once. Do not send keyboard or pointer input, reuse stale bindings, infer lock state from a timeout, or reset the spent previous budget.
stop_condition: Changed binary/profile precondition, ambiguous or absent window after one launch, lock screen, unrelated modal, second capture failure or total deadline.
